title: Field Key Expedition
intent: Create a small top-down exploration reference game combining simplified Emerald-like tile movement and Zero Mission-like equipment gates. Collect an upgrade, return to a barrier, open it and reach a new area. Use original abstract geometry, with no copied game assets.

components.adaptation: A simplified four-direction one-cell movement template. It does not reproduce Emerald's turn-in-place, frame timing or speed variants.
A simplified collectible key unlocks a typed barrier. It does not reproduce Zero Mission's owned/active equipment flags or native movement gates.
